items.exampleEn: My father goes to work by bus.
This is Lily. She is my cousin.
items.exampleZh: 這是 Lily，她是我的表妹。

items.exampleEn: Do you want tea or coffee?

items.exampleZh: 孩子們很喜歡他們的老師。

items.audioEn: Sam goes to school by bike, not by bus.
items.audioZh: Sam 騎腳踏車上學，不是搭公車。

items.sentenceEn: What do you want for dinner?
They can play in their garden.
items.sentenceZh: 他們可以在自己的花園裡玩。

items.passageEn: Lily and Sam are my friends. Their school is not near their home, so they go there by bus. Lily can sing very well. Sam can't sing, but he can draw. What do I like? I like to read books with them.
items.passageZh: Lily 和 Sam 是我的朋友。他們的學校離家不近，所以他們搭公車去上學。Lily 很會唱歌。Sam 不會唱歌，但他會畫畫。那我喜歡什麼呢？我喜歡和他們一起看書。

questions.questionZh: Lily 和 Sam 怎麼去上學？

rubricZh: can't 後面接原形動詞 speak
用 can 表示「可以」（例如 can sit）；寫 may 也正確
「坐這裡」可寫，例如 sit here、take this seat 等
